core.activation_checkpointing: Recompute blocks during backward to reduce activation memory.
core.attention_backend: Core attention implementation: torch, flash_2, flash_3 or flash_4; hardware/model qualification is separate.
core.checkpoint_compact_storage: Compact tensor storage before native checkpoint writes.
core.checkpoint_constant_memory_planning: Use bounded-memory checkpoint planning; separate from async save (unsupported).
core.checkpoint_dedup_save_to_lowest_rank: Use the lowest rank for duplicated checkpoint entries; independent writer policy switch.
core.checkpoint_process_count: Optional spawned checkpoint worker count; positive integer.
core.checkpoint_thread_count: Optional checkpoint writer thread bucket count; positive integer.
core.compiler_cache_restore: Restore a compatible cache before worker startup.
core.compiler_cache_root: Shared cache root; null selects maintained default. WEKA custom paths require a TTL component.
core.diagnostic_interval: Interval for trainer contract diagnostics; zero disables periodic diagnostics.
core.expert_parallel_size: Expert-parallel group size; must divide trainer world size.
core.expert_publication: per_expert exports separate HF expert slices; fused publishes stacked serving tensors. Disk HF export remains per-expert.
core.max_policy_lag: Maximum optimizer-step age at consumption; multiple updates per collection also consume this allowance.
core.max_sequence_length: Trainer context limit in tokens; structured max_context_length sets trainer and serving limits together.
core.max_train_rollout_logprob_abs_diff: Fail when mean absolute active-token trainer/serving log-probability gap exceeds this value; null disables. Despite the name, this is a mean, not a maximum.
core.model_config: Optional Core model factory configuration path for supported construction.
core.packing_max_tokens: Maximum tokens per pack; null uses context limit. Must cover max_sequence_length; samples are never split.
core.replay_diagnostics: Retain expert-ID replay diagnostics; does not enable replay itself.
core.reward_config: Trusted verifier registry path; structured workflow preparation supplies it.
core.router_aux_loss_weight: Coefficient for native Core load-balancing auxiliary loss; with packing, use packed-forward local-batch semantics.
core.router_z_loss_weight: Router z-loss coefficient; replay does not itself disable router losses or gradients.
core.row_specialization: static specializes no-gradient SwiGLU on capacity; dynamic avoids capacity-specific compilation. Independent of arithmetic flags.
core.scoring_check_interval: Periodic standalone-versus-training score check; startup/resume also checks the first update.
core.scoring_check_tolerance: Allowed absolute difference for the standalone/training scoring check.
core.scoring_pass_required: Force standalone scoring even when the recipe permits skipping it.
core.sequence_packing: Pack complete samples within each optimizer partition using document-isolated attention/KDA and replay alignment.
core.stream_moe_export: Stream MoE tensors during HF-layout publication to reduce export memory.
core.weight_sync_mode: flattened batches tensor transfers; per_tensor is the rollback/reference transport.

native.allgather_cp: Inherited context-parallel gather control; Core trainer CP must be one.
native.apply_chat_template: Render input messages through the model tokenizer chat template; avoid double rendering prepared prompts.
native.apply_chat_template_kwargs: JSON arguments passed to chat-template rendering.
native.async_save: Asynchronous native checkpoint writes; Core requires false.
native.attn_implementation: Inherited FSDP attention selector; Core rejects it in favor of core.attention_backend.
native.calculate_per_token_loss: Use token-count rather than response-count loss normalization; changes weighting across response lengths.
native.check_weight_update_equal: Compare serving tensors with published trainer weights; expensive full equality diagnostic.
native.ci_check_model_hash: Inherited CI model-hash verification; not an ordinary Core qualification gate.
native.ci_disable_kl_checker: Inherited CI switch disabling the KL checker; does not disable Core policy checks.
native.ci_disable_logprobs_checker: Inherited CI switch disabling its log-probability checker; separate from Core contract guards.
native.ci_disable_weight_update_checker: Inherited CI checker override; not a substitute for Core publication checks.
native.ci_metric_checker_key: Metric key inspected by the inherited CI threshold checker.
native.ci_metric_checker_threshold: Threshold used by the inherited CI metric checker.
native.ci_test: Enable inherited MILES CI behavior; use dedicated Core audits to establish Core correctness.
native.clip_grad: Maximum gradient norm for clipping before optimizer update.
native.context_parallel_size: Trainer context-parallel size; this adapter requires one.
native.custom_megatron_before_log_prob_hook_pat: Megatron scoring hook; not called by the Core adapter.
native.custom_megatron_before_train_step_hook_p: Megatron training-step hook; not called by the Core adapter.
native.custom_megatron_init_path: Megatron initialization hook; not called by the Core adapter.
native.delay_split_train_data_by_dp: Inherited data-parallel split timing control; do not assume it changes Core sample partitioning.
native.deterministic_mode: Inherited trainer determinism mode; Core rejects enabling it. Serving determinism controls are separate.
native.distributed_backend: Distributed process-group backend requested by MILES runtime helpers.
native.dp_replicate_size: Inherited FSDP replication dimension; Core requires one.
native.eval_interval: Collections between held-out evaluations; structured workflow requires eval data.
native.eval_min_new_tokens: Minimum new tokens during evaluation; may delay stopping.
native.eval_sglang_forward_pass_metrics_ipc_nam: Evaluation-server override of the SGLang forward-metrics IPC channel name.
native.eval_sglang_forward_pass_metrics_worker_: Evaluation-server override of the forward-metrics worker identity.
native.eval_temperature: Evaluation sampling temperature; zero selects greedy evaluation.
native.eval_top_k: Evaluation top-k sampling limit; native sentinel values retain native semantics.
native.fp16: Inherited FP16 training switch; Core requires false.
native.freeze_indexer: Inherited model indexer freezing control; no generic Core model support is implied.
native.fsdp_cpu_backend: Inherited MILES FSDP CPU process-group backend; not a Core trainer backend selector.
native.fsdp_cpu_offload: Inherited MILES FSDP CPU offload control; Core trainer offload is unsupported.
native.fsdp_state_dict_cpu_offload: Inherited FSDP state-dict policy; does not select the native Core checkpoint writer.
native.global_batch_size: Responses per optimizer update; must divide the collection and be divisible by trainer world size.
native.gradient_checkpointing: Inherited FSDP setting; rejected in favor of core.activation_checkpointing.
native.http_proxy: HTTP proxy URL for runtime network requests; keep credentials in secrets, not TOML.
native.keep_fp32_master: Retain FP32 optimizer master weights; Core requires true.
native.load: Native training checkpoint input for model/optimizer resume; distinct from hf_checkpoint input descriptor.
native.lr_decay_iters: Number of optimizer iterations used by the selected LR decay schedule.
native.lr_decay_style: Learning-rate schedule family; supported choices are listed in the parser metadata.
native.lr_warmup_fraction: Warmup as a fraction of the schedule; use consistently with explicit warmup iterations.
native.lr_warmup_init: Initial learning rate at the start of warmup.
native.lr_wsd_decay_iters: Decay iteration count for the warmup-stable-decay schedule.
native.lr_wsd_decay_style: Decay shape used by the warmup-stable-decay schedule.
native.memory_recorder: Inherited runtime memory-recording facility; separate from Core contract memory metrics.
native.memory_snapshot_dir: Directory for inherited memory snapshot output.
native.memory_snapshot_num_steps: Number of steps captured by the inherited memory snapshot facility.
native.memory_snapshot_path: Path for inherited PyTorch memory snapshot output.
native.micro_batch_size: Core requires one; use sequence_packing to combine document-isolated samples.
native.min_lr: Minimum learning rate at the end of decay.
native.mlflow_run_id: Existing MLflow run identifier for the native logging integration.
native.mtp_loss_scaling_factor: Inherited multi-token-prediction auxiliary coefficient; no Core MTP training support is implied.
native.mtp_num_layers: Inherited multi-token-prediction layer count; no Core MTP training support is implied.
native.multi_lora_adapters: Inherited adapter collection; Core LoRA training is unsupported.
native.normalize_advantages: Normalize advantages in the shared objective; separate from within-group GRPO standard-deviation normalization.
native.olmo_core_config: Serialized CoreConfig injected by the adapter; cannot override directly.
native.override_lr_scheduler: Replace loaded scheduler configuration; Core requires false when present.
native.padded_vocab_size: Inherited model vocabulary padding control; cannot substitute for a compatible HF/Core descriptor.
native.profile_step_end: Last step selected by the inherited profiler.
native.profile_step_start: First step selected by the inherited profiler.
native.profile_target: Native profiling target selection; available targets depend on the installed runtime.
native.record_memory_history: Enable inherited PyTorch memory-history capture; distinct from Core diagnostic_interval.
native.rollout_task_type: Native rollout task type selector; does not register unsupported Open Instruct tasks/verifiers.
native.save: Native checkpoint output directory; structured output.root supplies its default.
native.save_debug_event_data: Native debug event output; separate from retained Core contract and driver timing reports.
native.save_interval: Collections between native saves. Core saves synchronously.
native.seed: Training/randomness seed; structured default comes from data.seed.
native.sglang_forward_pass_metrics_ipc_name: IPC channel name used by SGLang forward-pass metrics.
native.sglang_forward_pass_metrics_worker_id: Worker identity used by SGLang forward-pass metrics.
native.sglang_server_concurrency: Client request concurrency per engine; raise together with engine admission and cache capacity.
native.sglang_speculative_draft_window_size: Speculative-decoding draft-window size; requires a compatible serving mode/model.
native.tb_experiment_name: Experiment name for native TensorBoard logging.
native.use_checkpoint_lr_scheduler: Restore checkpoint scheduler state; Core requires true when present.
native.use_distributed_post: Native distributed HTTP request dispatch switch; not a trainer parallelism selector.
native.use_mlflow: Enable native MLflow reporting; requires its runtime service/dependencies.
native.use_prometheus: Enable native Prometheus reporting where implemented.
native.use_pytorch_profiler: Enable inherited PyTorch profiling; verify the intended actor supports it before interpreting absent traces.
native.wandb_key: Native W&B credential option; prefer WANDB_API_KEY through launch.secrets instead of storing a token here.
native.wandb_run_id: Existing W&B run identity for tracking continuation.
native.warmup_ratio: Inherited FSDP option; rejected in favor of miles.lr_warmup_fraction.

special.dynamic_batching: Boolean alias for miles.use_dynamic_batch_size; Core validation still constrains supported modes.
special.gpus: Only trainer/inference: trainer GPUs per node or total rollout GPUs, respectively.
special.max_context_length: Positive token limit applied to Core, SGLang and rollout context.
special.off_policy_correction: tis only; enables use_tis and requires use_rollout_logprobs=false.
special.recompute_mode: full or off; resolves Core block activation checkpointing.
special.save_checkpoints: Boolean, default true; false removes save cadence and conflicts with explicit save_interval.
special.trainer_diagnostics: Boolean mapped to core.diagnostic_interval as 1 or 0.
special.trainer_flash_attention_version: 2, 3 or 4; selects corresponding Core flash backend, not a hardware qualification.

structured.compiler_cache.shared_root: Shared cache path; maps to core.compiler_cache_root. Default shared TTL root documented in cache guide.
structured.conversion.hf_output: Prepared HF descriptor/export path; default output.root/prepared/hf.
structured.data.eval_prompt_data: List alternating dataset names and held-out JSONL paths; paths resolve relative to TOML.
structured.data.prompt_data: Prepared training JSONL path; exclusive data selector. Pair with reward_config.
structured.data.recipe: Rejected: named olmo-miles recipes are not ported. Use tasks or an immutable manifest.
structured.data.reward_config: Trusted verifier registry path for prepared inputs.
structured.data.rl_manifest: Path to immutable prepared manifest with supported verifier contracts; exclusive data selector.
structured.data.seed: Nonnegative integer, default 17; controls preparation and default rollout seeds.
structured.data.shuffle: Boolean, default true; shuffle prepared training data.
structured.data.tasks: Nonempty array of unique task tables; cannot combine with another data selector.
structured.data.tasks[].eval_count: Positive integer number of held-out prompts; omit for no held-out rows from this task.
structured.data.tasks[].prompt_wrapper: Task rendering wrapper: none, auto or open_instruct_rlzero_answer; default none. See data guide.
structured.data.tasks[].task: Required named task: gsm8k, math, ifeval or multiplication.
structured.data.tasks[].train_count: Positive integer number of training prompts. At least one task must select training data.
structured.judges.NAME.backend: Managed only: sglang (default and only supported value).
structured.judges.NAME.chat_template: Managed only: qwen3-no-thinking (default and only supported template).
structured.judges.NAME.endpoint: External only: required HTTP(S) endpoint without embedded credentials.
structured.judges.NAME.gpus: Managed only: positive GPU count, default 1; must equal tensor_parallel_size.
structured.judges.NAME.mode: Required managed or external; determines service ownership.
structured.judges.NAME.model: Required model identifier used by the judge.
structured.judges.NAME.prepared_dir: Managed only: required absolute pre-cached judge directory; prepare before GPU allocation.
structured.judges.NAME.revision: Managed only: required immutable 40-character hexadecimal model revision.
structured.judges.NAME.tensor_parallel_size: Managed only: positive TP count, default 1.
structured.judges.NAME.timeout: Positive seconds per judge request, default 120.
structured.judging.bindings.VERIFIER.judge: Required name of a declared judge.
structured.judging.bindings.VERIFIER.rubric: Required name of a declared rubric.
structured.launch.auto_resume: Boolean, default true; Beaker restart policy. Multi-node/managed jobs require false.
structured.launch.cluster: Cluster string; default ai2/holmes for GPU runs. CPU-only WEKA work requires ai2/saturn.
structured.launch.coordination.heartbeat_timeout: Positive seconds for replica heartbeat timeout; default 120.
structured.launch.coordination.startup_timeout: Positive seconds to await coordinated startup; default 1200.
structured.launch.env: Environment-name to nonsecret string mapping, default empty; rank/Ray/CUDA variables are reserved.
structured.launch.gpus_per_replica: Positive integer physical GPUs per replica; inferred from topology if omitted.
structured.launch.priority: low, normal, high or urgent; default urgent.
structured.launch.secrets: Environment-name to Beaker secret-name mapping, default empty; no overlap with env.
structured.launch.shared_memory: Shared memory quantity string; default 200 GiB.
structured.launch.timeout: Beaker task timeout duration string; default 3h (examples override).
structured.launch.weka_mounts: Array of filesystem/mount tables; default oe-training-default at /weka/oe-training-default.
structured.launch.weka_mounts[].mount_path: Absolute/resolved destination; distinct nonoverlapping directories below root.
structured.launch.weka_mounts[].weka: WEKA filesystem name; unique per mount.
structured.model.format: hf (default) or olmo_core. Megatron checkpoint inputs are rejected.
structured.model.hf_template: Required only for native olmo_core input; compatible HF architecture/tokenizer template path.
structured.model.reference_hf: Rejected baseline conversion-validation field; use miles.ref_load for a frozen KL reference.
structured.model.source: Required checkpoint path, resolved relative to the run file; input remains read-only.
structured.name: Required run identifier: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens; starts with a letter/digit.
structured.output.export_hf: Boolean, default false. Export final HF weights after training.
structured.output.hf_dir: Final HF export path; default output.root/export-hf.
structured.output.root: Required fresh run directory. Resume requires matching recorded specification; completed runs cannot be overwritten.
structured.rubrics.NAME.max_response_tokens: Positive judge output reservation, default 2048; smaller than judge context.
structured.rubrics.NAME.profile: Required supported open-instruct/general-* profile; see managed judges guide.
